_comment: Round 3: 8 findings closed, of which 2 were defects introduced by round 2's FIXES (again at shifted lines: 40->46, 104->119). One further finding is a REWORDED, rule-less restatement of a round-2 finding at src/api/upload.ts — it cannot fingerprint-match, so it must surface through the weaker near-match layer as SUSPECTED. The web/report.tsx entry deliberately shares a rule with round 1's but names a different symbol, proving `symbol` disambiguates two instances of one rule in one file rather than collapsing them.
